blockingIssues.description: The overallTimeoutId uses setTimeout with an asynchronous throw. Since it runs in a different tick, throwing an Error here will not be caught by the try/catch block in run(). It will crash the Node process with an 'Uncaught Exception' instead of creating and persisting the synthetic timeout verdict as intended.

appliedUpdates.description: Added documentation about cross-platform differences when using child_process.spawn on Windows requiring cmd.exe.
Added documentation about AJV missing native date-time support and requiring ajv-formats.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the project's 500-line ESLint limit for test files, which requires workers to split up large test suites (e.g., into extended files).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Worker for milestone-gate had to split tests into two files to meet a 500-line ESLint limit.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document that validation contract AREA codes can contain digits (e.g., VAL-E2E-001).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Worker for validation-contract-parser failed initial regex matching by assuming area codes were strictly alphabetic.
